# Spellstick announcer: recording script

<!-- Generated by `npm run announcer:script` from src/content/announcer.ts. Edit the lines there, not here. -->

28 lines, each recorded twice: 56 files. The game picks a line when the moment happens and shows it as text at the bottom of the screen; if there's a recording for it, it's spoken too.

The announcer is a home announcer for the player's team. Each line has a regular take, used when the moment favors the player's team, and an **angry take** (`<id>-against.mp3`), used when it favors the opponent: they score, their goalie robs you, they flatten one of yours, you blow the shot clock. Same words, different read. If a line has no angry take yet, the regular one plays.

## The voice

- An arena announcer for a brutal, magical sport played by witches: big, warm, a little theatrical, having the time of their life.
- Short and punchy. Most lines should be under 1.5 seconds, none over about 3. Lines can cut each other off, so a quick read beats a long build.
- Read each line as written. The witch-flavored exclamations are from the Warlock books; say them like set phrases: "Child's Tantrum!", "Crone's Corns!", "Third-witch in!".
- Record two or three takes of anything you like and pick the best; only one file per id goes in.

## Files

- Two files per line: `<id>.mp3` and `<id>-against.mp3` (`.ogg` and `.wav` also work), for example `goal-01.mp3` and `goal-01-against.mp3`.
- Put them in `src/content/announcer-voice/`, commit, and push. Lines without a file stay text-only, so you can add them a few at a time.
- Mono, 44.1 or 48 kHz, MP3 at 96–128 kbps. Trim tight (no more than about 50 ms of silence at either end). Peaks around −1 dBFS, and keep all lines at a similar loudness.
- If you use a text-to-speech service, paste the delivery note for each take as the voice direction. (`npm run announcer:voice` does this with ElevenLabs.)

## Goal

**When:** A goal is scored. Against: the opponent scored.  
**Regular take:** Big and loud; the top of your range. Celebrate.  
**Angry take:** Furious and disgusted, like the home team just got burned.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Crone's Corns! It's in! | `goal-01.mp3` | `goal-01-against.mp3` |
| Top shelf! | `goal-02.mp3` | `goal-02-against.mp3` |
| Buried it! | `goal-03.mp3` | `goal-03-against.mp3` |
| Into the twine! | `goal-04.mp3` | `goal-04-against.mp3` |
| Child's Tantrum, what a finish! | `goal-05.mp3` | `goal-05-against.mp3` |

## Overtime winner

**When:** The sudden-death overtime winner; the match is over. Against: the opponent won it.  
**Regular take:** The biggest call in the game. Full release, a little longer if it wants to be.  
**Angry take:** Outraged disbelief: the home side just lost it all.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Crone's Corns, it's over! | `otwin-01.mp3` | `otwin-01-against.mp3` |
| Child's Tantrum! Sudden death, and that's the game! | `otwin-02.mp3` | `otwin-02-against.mp3` |

## Save

**When:** The goalie stops a shot. Against: the opponent's goalie robbed the player's team.  
**Regular take:** Sharp and punchy, impressed.  
**Angry take:** Angry and bitter, like a robbery.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stopped cold! | `save-01.mp3` | `save-01-against.mp3` |
| Big save! | `save-02.mp3` | `save-02-against.mp3` |
| Robbed! | `save-03.mp3` | `save-03-against.mp3` |
| The keeper says no! | `save-04.mp3` | `save-04-against.mp3` |

## Ward block

**When:** The goalie's magic shield blocks a shot that would have gone in. Against: the opponent's goalie did it.  
**Regular take:** Awed; a touch of wonder in it.  
**Angry take:** Angry: the shield cheated the home side.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Warded off! | `ward-01.mp3` | `ward-01-against.mp3` |
| The Ward holds! | `ward-02.mp3` | `ward-02-against.mp3` |
| Turned away by the Ward! | `ward-03.mp3` | `ward-03-against.mp3` |

## Big hit

**When:** A player is slammed into the boards, or a check knocks the ball loose. Against: it's one of the player's team getting flattened.  
**Regular take:** Excited: the crowd loves the violence. No laughing.  
**Angry take:** Angry, protective of your own.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Child's Tantrum! | `hit-01.mp3` | `hit-01-against.mp3` |
| Into the boards! | `hit-02.mp3` | `hit-02-against.mp3` |
| Flattened! | `hit-03.mp3` | `hit-03-against.mp3` |
| What a hit! | `hit-04.mp3` | `hit-04-against.mp3` |
| Crone's Corns! | `hit-05.mp3` | `hit-05-against.mp3` |

## Pile-up

**When:** A hit in a crowd of players. Against: the opponent threw it.  
**Regular take:** Excited, like a fight just broke out. "Third-witch in" is a set phrase: say it as one.  
**Angry take:** Angry, like the other side started it.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Third-witch in! | `pileup-01.mp3` | `pileup-01-against.mp3` |
| Third-witch in, and it gets ugly! | `pileup-02.mp3` | `pileup-02-against.mp3` |

## Turnover

**When:** A player loses the ball (stripped or intercepted). Against: the player's team lost it.  
**Regular take:** Quick, a little scornful of the other side.  
**Angry take:** Angry and exasperated at the home side.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stripped! | `turnover-01.mp3` | `turnover-01-against.mp3` |
| Coughed it up! | `turnover-02.mp3` | `turnover-02-against.mp3` |
| Picked clean! | `turnover-03.mp3` | `turnover-03-against.mp3` |

## Shot clock violation

**When:** A team runs out the 30-second shot clock. Against: the player's team ran it out.  
**Regular take:** Mock-exasperated, like a ref call.  
**Angry take:** Angry and frustrated with the home side.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shot clock! That one belongs to the other side. | `shotclock-01.mp3` | `shotclock-01-against.mp3` |
| Too slow! Shot clock! | `shotclock-02.mp3` | `shotclock-02-against.mp3` |

## Crease violation

**When:** An attacker carries the ball into the goalie's crease, or a goal is waved off for it. Against: the player's team did it.  
**Regular take:** Firm, like a ref call.  
**Angry take:** Angry, like it cost the home side.

| Line | Regular take | Angry take |
| --- | --- | --- |
| In the crease! Turnover. | `crease-01.mp3` | `crease-01-against.mp3` |
| Crease violation! | `crease-02.mp3` | `crease-02-against.mp3` |
